name: WdRowHeightRule
description: Specifies the rule for determining the height of the specified cells or rows.

constants.name: wdRowHeightAuto
constants.description: The row height is adjusted to accommodate the tallest value in the row.

constants.name: wdRowHeightAtLeast
constants.description: The row height is at least a minimum specified value.

constants.name: wdRowHeightExactly
constants.description: The row height is an exact value.
